decisions.reason: Specifying that help text appears on both the label and the field does not change the existing requirement that placeholder text clear when the field is activated.
The help-text location decision does not change the required editable-field mechanism, intended use, or handling of legacy controls.
The source concerns help text on interactive field labels and fields, not graphic bullet appearance.
The decision about field-help placement does not add, remove, or change any required style-system entry.
The source does not address or alter the required template theme colors.
Field-help placement is independent of legacy-to-new template copy-paste behavior.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The help-text location decision does not affect Tab-controlled list levels or hierarchy alignment.
The source does not address table structures, page margins, or pasted table content.
The field-help placement decision does not change the task-local assessment steps, coverage, budget, or outputs.
